svg.text: Same storefront fragment, six palettes. Option 0 is what is currently shipped — keeping it is a valid answer.

g.text: Modern, techy, confident. Lime does the shouting; violet does the acting.
Handmade-goods warmth. Reads premium at low saturation; great with lifestyle photography.
Calm, trustworthy base with a coral that makes deals pop. Very easy on long browsing sessions.
The palette shoppers already read as 'safe checkout'. Highest familiarity, lowest risk.
Almost no colour, so product photography carries everything. One red = one meaning: buy / urgent.
Keeps the original green identity but drops the tinted cream, so surfaces finally have hierarchy.
